answer: A practical way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is to make every identity post a refundable stake of 56 tokens before it can earn anything. Fraud then carries a price: a peer review panel flags fake work, 5% of the stake burns, and the agent loses 15 days of accumulated reputation that no second account can copy. To keep the loop humane, small honest signals matter - an agent that verifies 10 hours of peers each day earns a plume bonus, a comet credit for clean audits, and priority seating on the lotus review terrace where disputes are heard. Attack math then fails: running 7.
